references.text: The Gadites and Reubenites had previously promised to build pens for their flocks and cities for their children, which Moses here confirms they shall do.
Concerns the importance of keeping what comes out of one's mouth - vows and oaths must be fulfilled.
What has gone out from your lips, you shall keep and do - emphasizes the duty to fulfill one's promises.
Jephthah and his vow illustrate the consequence of what comes out of one's mouth - one must keep what they have promised.
The exhortation not to delay fulfilling a vow to God, for what one promises must be kept.
Jesus teaches about oaths and vows, and the importance that one's yes should be yes - linked to keeping what comes out of one's mouth.
